title: Hruday finite Euclidean readout certificate
selection_reason: AT2 yields a broad inverse-form interval and explicit equal-moment ambiguity. The skeptical review selects a finite-data reconstruction certificate as the bounded final target. It will supply a conditional tool and tested abstract benchmarks, not pretend to have computed AQ correlator samples.
target: Derive and execute a finite Euclidean-sample reconstruction of I=alpha<chi,H_phys^-1 chi> with certified quadrature, infinite-time tail, sample and arithmetic errors; test it on AT2's two atomic equal-moment fixtures.
model: The actual AQ centered spectral measure and physical scales of AT1/AT2 supply the conditional theorem. Executed synthetic samples come ONLY from the declared abstract AT2 fixtures A and B, not from the actual AQ Hamiltonian.

dictionary.C(s): integral exp(-s*x) d eta(x), real nonnegative centered Euclidean correlation
dictionary.u_up: 94/125, first dimensionless energy moment upper bound
dictionary.sample_error: deterministic absolute error per sampled C, not independent Gaussian noise or a confidence interval

frozen_design.scope: Uniform readout guarantee for data meeting the declared absolute-error contract; no resource feasibility claim for producing those data

shared_candidate_route: Composite trapezoid weights are positive and sum T, so sample errors contribute at most T*epsilon
The exact cell Peano kernel gives 0<=Trap-integral_0^T C<=h^2*u_up/8, since integral_0^T C''<=u_up
The omitted tail is at most s_up*exp(-a*T)/a
Candidate interval: [Trap_sample-h^2*u_up/8-T*epsilon, Trap_sample+s_up*exp(-a*T)/a+T*epsilon], with certified arithmetic widened outward
Use exact exponential enclosures; a sampled or floating-point value alone does not certify the interval
required: Justify positivity, differentiability/integrated kernel and interchange through the actual finite moment hypotheses; retain physical units and hbar
Derive the quadrature error sign and global bound, not only a per-cell sup estimate or observed convergence
Freeze all design values before generating fixture outcomes; evaluate a rigorous tail and arithmetic enclosure
Implement all 4097-node finite-design semantics, allowing a proved geometric-sum evaluation for the atomic fixtures
Return intervals containing exact I_A=3/32 and I_B=1/10, including worst-case all-positive and all-negative sample error
Test whether the certified intervals distinguish A and B under this design; retain insufficient verdict if they overlap
Expose a reusable CSV/input evaluator or a precise deterministic API for actual data satisfying the same contract, with malformed length/design/error inputs rejected
State that no certified AQ correlation samples, AQ inverse response value, spectral pole or experimental apparatus has been produced
sources: https://dlmf.nist.gov/3.5 Section3.5(i), standard trapezoidal rule and error; full integrated-moment bound derived here
Abbott et al arxiv2605.20509v1, finite Euclidean data and smeared spectral observables
acceptance: Complete conditional analytic proof, rigorous exact/enclosed arithmetic and independent implementations, damaging controls, source-bound skeptical review. A successful fixture is not a measured or computed AQ response.
claim_exclusions: Computed actual AQ samples or response
New quadrature method or verified priority
stop: This is investigation3 of3. After review do only repairs, validation, editorial integration, prospective roadmap and publication. No fourth scientific investigation.
